name: offer-desk.release-path
purpose: Join the ranked release ladder with enabling urgency and optional stream prerequisites into one table answering what ships next and what blocks it.

stream_node_id.description: Stream node whose prerequisite tree is read. Omitted means prerequisites are not requested; the signal reports that rather than an empty tree.

include_retired.description: Include retired deliverables in the ladder and enabling reads.

assumptions: The board owns release ranking; this program joins and never re-ranks.
A deliverable is shipped when its status is TRIGGER_MET or RETIRED.
invariants: Release rank is copied from the board and never recomputed.
When every board read fails the status is unavailable, never an empty ladder.
Prerequisites are reported as not requested when no stream node is supplied.

bindings.note: Optional: a failed read leaves enabling urgency null and degrades to partial.
Called only when stream_node_id is supplied; the binding requires it.

signals.path: One row per ladder deliverable with rank, class, finish bar, unlocked ramp count, actuals mapping and the unshipped enablers blocking it.
signals.next_ready: Up to five unblocked, unshipped deliverables in board rank order.
signals.enabling_ranked: Enabling deliverables by the board's derived urgency.
signals.unmapped_actuals_count: Ladder deliverables with no ledger account, whose earnings are therefore unreadable.
signals.prerequisites: The requested stream's prerequisite deliverables, or null when not requested.

outputs.evidence: The board binding ids that answered.

fixtures.note: prerequisites_requested is false; prerequisites is null.
An unknown stream degrades the prerequisite read only; the ladder join still reports.
